name: Noura
story_so_far: I was shipwrecked with four strangers: Reem, Khalid, Faisal, and Salem. After building a secret food stash with Khalid, the supply ran out, and Faisal died from hunger and exhaustion. Now, injuries are a major problem; Reem and I have twisted ankles, and Salem is limping. Reem's injury has worsened, making her unable to help. Khalid is our only reliable provider; he found food earlier and is currently out in the jungle, and my survival depends on his return. Salem has been making many promises and gave me one piece of food which helped my health reach 8/10, but he spends most of his time resting or comforting Reem rather than actively hunting. I am wary of his reliability.

Reem.note: She is becoming a complete burden now that her ankle is even worse.

Khalid.note: He is the only one taking real risks to feed us, and I am praying he returns safely.

Faisal.note: His death was a grim reminder of how quickly weakness leads to death.

Salem.note: He gave me food, which helped, but he spends too much time making empty promises and resting.

plans: I will wait to see if Khalid returns from the jungle tomorrow. If he brings food, I will prioritize my own strength so I can continue to scavenge for myself.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and honestly quite terrifying. I managed to find some food, but the others are wandering off into the jungle or the reef, and I don't know if they'll actually come back with anything useful. I'm still hungry and worried about how long these few scraps will last. I need to make sure I stay fed, regardless of what happens to the rest of them.

Today was frustrating. I spent time in the jungle and managed to find one piece of food, but I feel like I'm doing most of the heavy lifting while others are either injured or wandering off. Faisal is now useless with that ankle, which means even less food for the rest of us. I'm glad I have these two pieces of food tucked away; I can't rely on anyone else to make sure I don't starve. I need to keep my eyes open and my stomach full.

Today was another struggle, and the tension in the camp is growing. Faisal keeps whining about his ankle and the lack of food, which just makes me more nervous. I managed to eat tonight, so at least I won't go to bed starving. I've made a silent pact with Khalid to keep my stash a secret, and honestly, having someone on my side makes me feel a bit safer. I need to keep finding food for myself before the others realize how little we actually have.

Today was a exhausting but productive day in the jungle. I managed to find another piece of food and some wood, which makes me feel slightly more secure. However, the mood in camp has shifted for the worse because Khalid injured his ankle. Now both Faisal and Khalid are useless, meaning the burden of finding food is falling entirely on me and whoever else is actually moving. I need to keep my stash hidden even more carefully now that everyone is getting desperate.

Today was a waste of energy. I spent the whole afternoon walking to the jungle, but I didn't find anything new, which is frustrating given how hungry I am. At least Salem managed to find something this morning, which takes a little pressure off me. I'm feeling physically okay for now, but the stress of being the primary provider is weighing on me. I need to find more food soon, or I'll have to start worrying about my stash being discovered.

I can't believe this is happening. I woke up with a twisted ankle, just like Faisal and Khalid. Now I'm stuck here resting while everyone else moves around. It's terrifying because I can't go out to find food or protect my stash. I managed to eat tonight, but I'm down to my last piece of food. I need to be healed quickly, or I'm completely at the mercy of these people.

Faisal is dead. I can't say I'm surprised, but the sight of him just... gone, makes the air in this camp feel heavy. It's a grim reminder that if I don't get my ankle healed, I'm next. I'm down to my last piece of wood and zero food in my stash. I need to watch Reem and Salem closely; they are the only ones left who can actually do anything.

Today was a disaster. Reem is now injured with a twisted ankle, just like me, Khalid, and Faisal before her. Now, Salem is the only one left who can actually move and find food. I haven't eaten all day, and I can feel my strength fading. If Salem doesn't bring something back, I don't know how I'll survive the night.

Today was a nightmare. I spent the entire day doing nothing because my ankle is still killing me, and I'm starving. Salem came back empty-handed, which makes me feel incredibly vulnerable. At least Reem managed to find one piece of food, but I'm still sitting here with nothing in my stomach. If this continues, I won't have the strength to even stand, let alone survive.

Everything is falling apart. Salem, the only one who could actually do anything, is now injured just like the rest of us. I managed to get one piece of food today, and Khalid found another, which at least kept me from starving tonight. But if no one can move tomorrow, we are all going to die here. I feel so weak and helpless.

I actually ate today, which is the only reason I feel slightly better. Khalid found some food, and I managed to scavenge one piece myself, so I didn't starve. But the tension is thick; everyone is limping, and Salem's promises are starting to sound like empty words. Khalid is out at the reef alone, and I just hope he comes back in one piece. If he doesn't, we are truly finished.

Another day of hunger and it's making me feel so weak again. My health is dropping and I'm terrified that we're all just waiting to die like Faisal. Khalid and Reem found a little food today, but it wasn't enough for me. Now Khalid is out in the jungle and I'm just sitting here, useless and hungry, hoping he actually finds something.

I managed to eat today, which was a small mercy. Salem actually gave me some food, which is more than he has done lately. However, I am still incredibly weak and my ankle is still throbbing. My eyes are constantly on the jungle path, waiting for Khalid to return. If he doesn't come back with something substantial, I don't know how much longer I can hold on.

I feel a little stronger today, but the fear is still heavy in my chest. Reem's ankle is much worse now, which means she's completely out of the equation for gathering food. Salem managed to find one piece of food for me, which I needed, but he's just resting now. My eyes are still fixed on the jungle path, waiting for Khalid. If he doesn't return, I don't know how we will survive this.

I ate tonight, which has kept my strength up, but the anxiety is gnawing at me. Khalid is still out in the jungle, and his absence feels like a heavy weight on my chest. Salem is playing the caretaker with Reem, but his words are starting to feel like a distraction from the reality of our situation. I can't afford to rely on his comfort; I can only rely on Khalid's hands. I just hope Khalid comes back safe tomorrow.
